item.text: {"analysis":"The candidate ran successfully but validation HR@10 fell from 0.665 to 0.630, a decrease of 0.035 (3.5 percentage points). The host selected epoch 20 out of 40 completed epochs. The identity-initialized output projection did not improve ranking in this seed-2024 trial; the result does not establish why it underperformed. Reject this change and retain the 0.665 baseline.","code_summary":"Position-free causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional tied item embeddings and eight independent residual blocks using dilations [1, 2, 4, 8, 1, 2, 4, 8]. Each block mixes local and dilated convolutions through a learned gate, followed by another dilated convolution, normalization, GELU, dropout, and learned per-channel residual scales. The candidate adds a bias-free 64×64 output projection (4,096 parameters), initialized to identity after existing initialization, before final padding masking. Both scoring interfaces use the projected representations. All eight constants and host-owned training and evaluation remain unchanged."}
